description: One journal entry in the signed repository (docs/REPO.md): its CID as a link and its height, the same for every reader. The entry's own bytes go only to a reader who may see it whole, beside the proof (com.atproto.sync.getRecord).

main.description: Record key: the rev of the commit that added it, TID(clock minute * 60e6 + height).

entry.description: The entry's hash: the CID of its canonical DAG-CBOR without `hash`.
